reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse while sharing linking, downloading and local unlinking across providers.

duplication.why: Consolidates repeated provider workflows and routes Fintegra through the same implementations without adding duplicate logic.

placement.why: Database link queries stay in accounts/link.ts, orchestration stays in accounts/app.ts, and transaction downloading stays in accounts/sync.ts.

scope.why: The refactors, provider types, client compatibility entries and tests directly support the four requested changes.

maintainability.why: Shared workflows and explicit provider variations are maintainable, though enforcing link policy through registration wrappers makes the orchestration less direct.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link registrations use refuseIfAlreadyLinked and linkBankSyncAccount, and both unlink paths use clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: Repeated linking and download implementations are consolidated rather than renamed or reshaped into parallel copies.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink adds one requested shared policy flag; closed-account validation and takeover remain common to every provider without provider-specific exceptions.
